name: finsider
description: Financial diligence worked like software: Claude, Codex and Cursor pick up Finsider Actions, work them with Finsider's verified tools and report on the Actions board.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Finsider account, pick up Actions (the steps of a diligence engagement) and work them with Finsider's tools while your session shows live on the Actions board. Financial values come from Finsider calculations; every change needs approval and the team moves finished work to Done.
